description.short: Create, search and manage Jira issues from Teams
description.full: Create issues, add comments, log time, search and update Jira issues directly from Microsoft Teams

commands.title: create
commands.description: Create a Jira issue — e.g. create PROJ Summary

commands.title: search
commands.description: Search issues — e.g. search login bug

commands.title: show
commands.description: Show issue details — e.g. show PROJ-123

commands.title: update
commands.description: Update status — e.g. update PROJ-123 Done

commands.title: comment
commands.description: Add comment — e.g. comment PROJ-123 Fixed in v2

commands.title: log
commands.description: Log time — e.g. log PROJ-123 2h Fixed the bug

commands.title: assign
commands.description: Assign issue — e.g. assign PROJ-123 user@domain.com

commands.title: Create issue in Jira
commands.description: Create a Jira issue from this Teams message

commands.title: Comment in Jira
commands.description: Add this message as a comment on a Jira issue

commands.title: Log time in Jira
commands.description: Log work time on a Jira issue

commands.title: Search Jira Issues
commands.description: Search for Jira issues and insert into message

parameters.name: searchQuery
parameters.title: Search
parameters.description: Search by issue key, summary or keyword
